column3: I will tell you what he\nmeant.{end_wait}
Only Alex could open\nthose seals. Where is he?{end_wait}
He opened the way for\nus, then went missing. We\ndon't know where he went.{end_wait}
We needed no more than the\nopen door. Water answers\nto the Star, not the hand.{end_wait}
Missing? Alex would never\nvanish! What did you do?!{end_wait}
{actor_name:4}, we did nothing.\nWe don't know where he is.{end_wait}
The lighthouse lent you\nstrength in that fight.\nYou felt it, surely.{end_wait}
Don't you see?{page_break}It fed you limitless\nPsynergy, girl.{end_wait}
You and Alex are both\nMercury Clan.{page_break}Masters of Water\nPsynergy.{end_wait}
Tell me why Saturos\ncouldn't use his full\npower.{end_wait}
Ah, yes... I will explain.{end_wait}
Saturos is of Mars,\nthe Adepts of fire.\nSo am I.{end_wait}
He knew. He failed to\nappreciate this lighthouse.{end_wait}
I watched your battle\nfrom the shadows...{end_wait}
I did not help Saturos.\nI was certain he'd win.{end_wait}
I was wrong. You have\nbecome fighters in a very\nshort time.{end_wait}
I was only keeping you\ntalking until Saturos\nrecovered.{end_wait}
You were stalling!\nThat's a trick!{end_wait}
No, it's impossible.\nNo Adept of our clan\nhas this kind of power.{end_wait}
Perhaps your clan never\nknew what it guarded.{end_wait}
It seems our way has\nreturned while we talked.{end_wait}
Oh? You mean to take the\nStars from Saturos?{end_now}
Ha! Too bad. I carry them\nnow. Come and take them!{end_wait}
Ha! You're right... I carry\nthe Elemental Stars!{end_wait}
Yes. We won't let them\nget away with this...{end_wait}
